text:
Alex: Quick idea for Run History UX: show a one-line condensed row for structured/tool-call runs that can expand. Want feedback on layout + accessibility. Marta: sketch pls — do you mean collapse each invocation or group by similar prompts? Alex: each invocation collapses. But add an optional grouping toggle to collapse repeated/similar runs. Condensed row shows prompt snippet, schema status, tool count, duration, and a small "Details" action. Sam: accessibility: the row needs keyboard focus and aria-expanded state. Prefer using a single focusable element that toggles expansion to reduce tab stops. Julia: copy nit: use "Details" instead of "Inspect"; also avoid "OK" for schema, use "Matches schema" or "Schema mismatch". Priya: UX nit: show first 1-2 key/value pairs for structured output inline in the preview (muted font). But warn about PII. Marta: visual: keep it single-line height with ellipsis; tooltip on hover/focus shows full prompt. On mobile, expand inline rather than open a panel. Alex: markup example I put together: ```
Summarize Q2 plan... Matches schema revenue: $X, goal: increase
...tool call timeline, payloads...
``` Sam: lazy-load the detailed JSON on expand to avoid heavy initial payloads. show spinner. announce load via aria-live. Julia: for copy, recommend label "Open run details for {time}" as visually-hidden prefix so screen readers get context. Also event names: analytics.record('run.details.open') etc. Priya: grouping behavior: add "Condense similar runs" toggle in user settings and a per-channel default. When grouped, show a summary header with count and a chevron to reveal the group. Marta: design action: I'll do two comps — single-row condensed and grouped stack — and include masked-value states. Can deliver by EOD tomorrow. Alex: eng action: implement aria-expanded toggle, lazy-load, and group toggle. Sam will prototype keyboard flows. Sam: I'll open a draft PR and add keyboard/voiceover test notes. DesignBot: attached mock: run-history-condensed-row-v1.png and added follow-up reminder for 48h. Julia: QA: I'll add NVDA/VoiceOver test cases and a checklist for PII masking on previews. Priya: small perf note: prefetch details for most-recent 5 runs in viewport to make expansion snappier. Alex: agree. One more UX thought: allow users to pin specific runs so they always show expanded. Marta: good idea. We'll add a pin affordance on the row. Alex: action list summarized: design comps (Marta), eng PR + lazy-load (Sam + eng), copy updates (Julia), PII policy check (Priya), analytics events (Alex). Sam: PR link (WIP): https://git.redwood/infra/run-history-condense-proto Alex: thanks all. Reconvene after comps. :thumbsup:
